item.title: More Wichita (KS) Fire Stations Could Close Temporarily During Mold Remediation

item.title: Contentious CA Firehouse Issue Heads to Voters
item.description: Ross, California, will vote in November on an initiative to reopen its fire station, following a council decision amid ongoing debates about public safety and emergency response in the community. item.title: Cantankerous Wisdom: Running Quiet and Eating Crow
item.description: Two unpleasant thoughts during 50 years as an active volunteer were the threat of responding to alarms without using warning lights and sirens (running quiet) and eating crow (admitting you were wrong).
